blocks.text: Students sit the exam in Examplify on iPad. Once the exam starts, the app locks the device. Screenshots, copy-paste, and internet access all stop until the exam ends.
Results appear in the assessment overview within minutes of students uploading their answer files.

items.d: Find questions the class missed or where distractors did not work. Candidates for scoring adjustments or retirement.
Performance by topic across the cohort.

blocks.text: After reviewing item analysis, you may need to adjust scoring on individual questions. Common adjustments include granting full credit on a flawed question or accepting an additional correct answer.

blocks.title: Coordinate scoring changes with OME
blocks.text: Email OME before making adjustments so your changes and any adjustments OME has queued do not conflict.
Once scoring adjustments are final, OME releases the results. Students receive an email notification and can view their score in the Examplify app or the student portal.

blocks.title: Exam review follows the setting chosen before posting
blocks.text: If the assessment was set to Immediate review, students already saw their answers after uploading. If Delayed, students see them after the date you configured. If None, students see only their score.

items.label: Legacy Portal: Review Results and Adjust Scoring
